body.p: After you commit changes to your local repository, push them to make them available in the remote repository. Use the Push action from the Git Staging view toolbar, the Ellipsis menu, or the Git main menu.

Pull changes when you need to bring other people's commits from the remote repository into your local repository. Use one of the pull actions from the Pull drop-down menu in the Git Staging view toolbar (), the Ellipsis menu, or the Git main menu.
In the Pull drop-down menu, you can choose between Pull (merge) and Pull (rebase). The action you use becomes the default action of the toolbar button.

In the Ellipsis menu and in the Git main menu, the Pull... action lets you pull changes from a remote branch other than the tracked branch. This action opens a dialog box where you can choose the remote branch and the pull strategy, either merge or rebase.
body.note: When you push a local branch that does not have a corresponding remote branch, a remote branch with the same name is created automatically.
